d: Noble Panacea is a new revolutionary skincare brand, founded by Nobel Laureate Sir Fraser Stoddart, launched in October 2019. The ground-breaking OSMV™ Technology at the core of the brand enables transformational efficacy and precision. We create with intention and deep respect by adhering to the global principles of green chemistry. We take our commitment to nature and sustainability to all stages of product development, from R&D; to packaging. Ultimately, we strive to promote absolute skin health by empowering all who seek authentic, natural, and ageless beauty.

We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced, and service-oriented Beauty Advisor & Aesthetician. As a Noble Panacea Beauty Advisor & Aesthetician, you will represent the brand and offer in-depth knowledge of our products and technology. You will be responsible for sales performance, daily operations of the counter with emphasis on performing facials, personalized customer service, clienteling, and follow-up. You will provide welcoming, authentic, and personalized service to achieve all customer service and sales targets. With your passion for people; the environment and company; products and services, you will ensure that each customer has a unique and memorable in-store experience which educates, inspires, and delights them.

You will also use your exceptional people skills to build collaborative working relationships with the rest of your team to ensure that the counter along with the treatment room meet Noble Panacea’s high standards of visual merchandising. If you are passionate about beauty and luxury and an ambitious self-starter looking for a progressive career within the Retail Beauty Industry, then this could be the perfect role for you and a great opportunity to be part of a dynamic and passionate team.
q: 5 years of experience working as a Beauty Advisor
Experience preferably with luxury/niche skincare brands
